conditional_input_fields.effort: In the example, but present only when the current model supports the effort parameter.
conditional_input_fields.session_crons: In the example, but conditional in practice -- an ABSENT list is not the same fact as an EMPTY one (the example carries an empty one). Same shape and same 1000-character prompt cap as Stop.
conditional_input_fields.background_tasks: In the example, but conditional in practice -- treat an absent list as 'unknown', never as 'no tasks running'.

notes: Same decision control as Stop; reason required when decision is 'block'. agent_id and agent_type are UNCONDITIONAL here -- this event only ever fires for a subagent -- so they sit in the input_example and need no conditional slot.
